name: Reveler of Stories (Witch)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Witch form.

traits.name: Moral Quandary
traits.summary: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story of the reveler's theme: for 1 hour it can't take Reactions and its AC is 4 lower.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story that shares the theme of the reveler's Storied Form. The reveler is weakened for 1 hour: it can't take Reactions and its AC is reduced by 4.

traits.name: Storied Form (Witch)
traits.summary: This is the Witch form: it embodies tales of wicked magicians.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Great Beast, Hero or Witch. The form sets some traits and the theme of stories it embodies (powerful monsters, brave heroes, wicked magicians). This block is the Witch form.

traits.name: Terror Feeding (Witch Only)
traits.summary: If a Frightened creature is within 30 ft at the end of its turn, it gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.
traits.text: If at least one creature with the Frightened condition is within 30 feet of the reveler at the end of its turn, the reveler gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Thrash attacks; one can be its Fabled Assault when ready.
actions.text: The reveler makes three Thrash attacks. It can replace one with its Fabled Assault if that is ready.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.text: A blow of storybook force: 18 (3d8 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Wicked Storm (Fabled Assault, Witch)
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 60-ft cone, DC 17 Dex save: 6d8 Lightning (half on a success); a failure is Frightened with Speed 0, repeating the save each turn, and ends after 1 minute.
actions.text: Dexterity save, DC 17, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (6d8) Lightning damage, and the target is Frightened. While Frightened this way its Speed is 0. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and after 1 minute it succeeds automatically. Success: half damage only.

reactions.name: Dramatic Reversal
reactions.trigger: It is hit by an attack roll.
reactions.summary: Reaction: +4 AC against the attack that hit it, possibly turning it into a miss.
reactions.text: Trigger: an attack roll hits the reveler. Response: it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

summary: A fiend born of old stories that hammers with storybook force, here in a witch form that casts a frightening lightning storm.
